text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Rem had finally acquired a lot of experience in the fun activities of summer. Then one day
text_block_list.orig_text:
『夏の海』について様々な経験をしてきたレム。
そんなある日のこと──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: There's no need to thank me...
text_block_list.orig_text: お礼だなんてそんな……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Rem only did it because she wanted to, so there's no way I could accept something in return...
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムは自分がやりたいからやっただけなので、
そのようなものを受け取るわけには……

text_block_list.name: Beach house owner
text_block_list.text: Come ooon, Rem-chan, you said that the other day too and then ended up not accepting anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～
レムちゃん、
こないだもそう言って受け取ってくれなかったじゃねーか。

text_block_list.name: Beach house owner
text_block_list.text: On that day Rem-chan and that boy came to help our beach house, we were in a desperate pinch due to the rare unexpected number of customers. You were like angels who came down to help us. That's why I want to thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムちゃんたちがヘルプに入ってくれたあの日ね、
稀に見る予想外の客数で、
絶体絶命のピンチだったんだよ。
めちゃくちゃ助かったの。
だから
気持ちよ気持ち。

text_block_list.name: Beach house owner
text_block_list.text: This isn't meant to be a part-time wage correspondence. I just happened to get it by chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これね、
バイト代じゃないの。
たまたま偶然もらったやつでさ。

text_block_list.name: Beach house owner
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to use it, so I'll give it to you. Take it. Okay? Here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺、
使わないから。
あげる。
もらって。
ね？　
はいっ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: But, as I sa-...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ですが……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Oh, he's gone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
行ってしまいました……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Is this... some kind of partecipation ticket for something...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは、
なにかの参加券、
でしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: "Para-sai-ling"? Umm, Rem doesn't really know what that means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『ぱらせーりんぐ』？
ええと、
レムにはそれがなんのことなのか……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: So it's a participation ticket for a game that is so popular that it's hard to get hold of, huh. I received something so valuable out of the blue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人気過ぎてなかなか手に入らない遊びの参加券、
というわけですか。
思いがけず
貴重なものをいただいてしまいました。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: If it's really that popular, then this would make Subaru-kun happy! I wonder if my Sister and Lady Emilia would want to ride on it too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それほどまでに人気ということであれば、
これはスバルくんが喜びそうです！
姉様やエミリア様も乗りたがるでしょうか。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: By Rem, you say? However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムがですか？　
ですが……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Umm... Rem will be troubled if you keep looking at her with such pleading eyes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの……
そのように訴えかける目で見られては、
レムも困ってしまいます……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. You're completely right, the owner of that beach house gave this to Rem as a gift. Rem should enjoy it first and then thank him for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わかりました。
確かに、
あの海の家のご店主様は
レムへの贈り物としてこれをくださいました。
レムがまずは楽しんで、
きちんとお礼を言わなきゃですね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, then, this time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
では、
今回は。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: This time it won't be to experience it or to research, but Rem will enjoy it for Rem's sake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
体験でもリサーチでもなく、
レムがレムのために、
楽しませていただこうと思います。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. It seems this activity has a two-seater.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ。
こちら、
二人乗りのようですよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: What should we do...?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしましょうか……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rem. Bro. What are you two talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よう。
レム、
兄弟。
お揃いで何話してんだ？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Subaru-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text: スバルくん！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I was wondering why you've been so busy lately, Rem. If there's anything difficult you might need help for, you can always tell me. Despite how I look, I've got a lot of free time left until Beako gets her things sorted back home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここ最近、
レムはずいぶん忙しくしてたみたいで
気になってたんだ。
何か大変なことがあるなら
いつでも言えよ。
こう見えて、
ベア子がうまくやるまで
結構暇で……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Eh? Wait, wait, wait! Rem, that's a parasailing ticket you've got there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──って、
待
て待て待て！
レムが持ってるそれ、
パラセーリングのチケットじゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: That's SO cool! It sounds so fun! It's a kind of activity I've wanted to try at least once while we're here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいなー！
めっちゃくちゃに面白そうで、
ここにいる間に一回はチャレンジしてみたかったアクティビティだぜ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Subaru-kun...
text_block_list.orig_text: スバルくん……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I see... So you were discussing over who'd take the other seat with Rem, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど……
誰が残りの一席に座るか
って話をしてたのか。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: But if you think about it logically, wouldn't it make sense for my Bro who helped out at the store to ride with Rem?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
普通に考えりゃ、
店を一緒に手伝った兄弟が
レムと乗るのが筋なんじゃねぇの？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I'd be lying if I said I don't want to ride it! I'm super jealous...! But, at the same time, I honestly didn't do anything to help. Sorry for the confusing reaction...
text_block_list.orig_text:
乗りたくないといったら嘘になる！　
超羨ましい！
でも、
今回は掛け値なしに何にもしてねぇからな、
俺。
ややこしいリアクションをしちまって申し訳ねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: No, please don't feel guilty about that. Subaru-kun's charm comes from his honesty and sincerity in everything he does.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
そんな反省なんてしないでください。
何事にも素直で正直なところも
スバルくんの魅力です。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Umm, if it's okay with you {0}, Rem is fine not going after all, so Subaru and the others could come for the ride...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
もしよろしければ、
やはりレムは結構ですので、
スバルくんたちで乗ってきていただいても……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: He's right, that's no good. The owner of the beach house will hate me and stop selling his delicious fried noodles to me only. Rem, you've got no chance but to go on board.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
それはダメだ。
海の家の店主に恨まれて
焼きそば売ってもらえなくなっちまう。
レムが乗るってのは
譲れねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: And as for the other one... Yeah. I'd rather it be you, Bro.
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
もう一人は……
うん。
やっぱり兄弟がいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: You... You're really are a good person, aren't you? Don't you have any self greed? But... that's exactly why I can't just come and take your seat with her out of nowhere...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前……
ほんっ
と底抜けにいいヤツだよな。
欲とかないの？
でも……
だからこそ、
俺が横から席を奪うなんてことはできないわけで……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...We're at a stalemate with no compromises. What should we do? If only there was a way to settle things in a black and white way without any regrets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
まさかの譲り合いで平行線だよ。
どうしたもんかね。
いっそのこと、
白黒きっぱり
後腐れなく決められる方法がありゃぁな。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: If that's the issue, how about having a contest and the winner gets to ride with me? For example, a shaved ice eating contest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでは、
何かで勝負をして
勝った方が乗るというのはいかがでしょう？
たとえば、
かき氷の早食べ対決とか……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: That'll get me a stomache after my head starts pounding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
頭キーンってなった後
お腹壊しちゃう！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Then, how about a swimsuit fashion style contest? You both look amazing in them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
水着の着こなし対決は？
お二人ともとっても似合っていましたから。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: It seems like the outcome of that contest would be decided by who the judges are! I'd like something that involves a bit more skill and luck...
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰を審査員にするかで勝負決まっちゃいそうだな！
もうちょっとこう、
実力と運が絡んだ勝負性のあるもんが……

text_block_list.name: Rem Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text: う～ん……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ............Ohhh! THAT'S IT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
………………
おおお！　
それだ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, a beach flags running competition was held between Subaru and {0}, with the right to go parasailing with Rem at stake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、レムと一緒にパラセーリングに乗る権利をかけて、
スバルと{0}とで、
ビーチフラッグ対決が行われることとなった。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Well then, if I may be so presumptuous. Rem will give the signal to begin and also determine the winner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
では僭越ながら。
レムが、
開始の合図と
勝者の見極めをさせていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And please try to avoid any favoritism since we're from the same world and all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう。
エコひいきはなしで頼むぜ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Of course, that's a given. Rem would like both of you to win if possible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんです。
レムは、
できればお二人ともに勝ってほしいと思っていますから。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: So you don't even care who ends up winning this?! Alright, Bro! No matter who wins, no hard feelings!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも勝つのは難しいけどね！？
よし、
兄弟！　
どっちが勝っても
恨みっこなしだぜ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Now, lie face down on the sand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
砂の上にうつぶせになって下さい。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: When the signal arrives, you'll both be running off and the one who first grabs the flag wins, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
合図と共に駆け出して、
あそこの旗を先にとった方が勝ち、
いいですか？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Okay!
text_block_list.orig_text: オッケー！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: There's no need to hold back anymore, Bro. Whoever wins gets to enjoy parasailing together with her. Whoever loses gets to watch from the ground with their fingers in their mouths!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなったら遠慮は無用だぜ、
兄弟。
勝った方が楽しくパラセーリング。
負けたら地上で指くわえて眺める！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's start this. Ready and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
いきます。
よーい……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: GO!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: どん！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...SHAAA!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──っしゃ！！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! The sand is in the way! I can't move my feet forward! It's harder to run than I thought...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う
わっ……！
砂が邪魔！　
足が前に出ねぇ！　
思った以上に走りにくい……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Damn it, I need GUTS here... DORYAAAAAAAAHHHHH! Two more meters... One more meter! I can do this! I'LL DO IT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソっ、
ド根性だ……
どりゃぁぁぁぁぁぁ！
あと２メートル……
１メートル！
いける！　
いけるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Bro! The one who'll be looking at the blue ocean from the sky... And the one who'll enjoy the wind from the sea rustling his hair will be...
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪いな兄弟！
空から青い海を眺めるのは……
そして
海の上に吹く風で、
髪をボッサボッサにするのは……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: MEEEEEEEEEEEE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
れ、
だーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...CRAAAAAP! I made an unexpected mistake at a crucial moment and missed it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──やべぇ！　
肝心なところでまさかのミス！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I threw myself on it with too much force and it flew off! The flag... WHERE IS IT...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
勢いつけすぎて弾いちまった！
旗は
どこに──！？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, the flag flew off course and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
旗がコースの外に飛んでっ……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Eh...? EEEEEHHHHHHHH?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ……！
ええええええーーーー！？！？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: The flag flew away and ended up in my Bro's hands...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
飛んでいった旗が、
兄弟の手の中に……！？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Huh, OI! Wait, wait, wait! Bro how and why did you even CATCH it?! And wait, WHY ARE YOU EVEN THERE?! That's COMPLETELY off course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
おい、
待て待て待てぃ！
なんで兄弟がキャッチ、
ってかなぜそこにいる！？
そこは完っ全っにコース外だろうが！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: He was helping Mr. Crab.
text_block_list.orig_text: カニさんを助けていたんです。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Mr. Crab?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……カニさん？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. He found something moving while on the path to the flag. He saw it and said: "There seems to be an injured crab, so I'm going to move it off the course", and he was in the middle of gently carrying it over there with both hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
旗までの進路上に
何か動くものを見つけたんです。
それを見て、
「怪我してるカニさんがいたから
コースの外に逃がす」と
あちらまで両手でそっと運んでいる途中でした。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: And that's when the flag we were both were aiming for came flying by accident, and landed snugly in your hands after you placed the crab down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこへ俺が弾いた旗が偶然飛んできて、
カニさんを置いた後の手にすっぽりハマったと。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Right, right... AS IF!!!!!!! What kind of miracle is this!? You helped "Mr. Crab" and caused an upset just like that?! What is this, A FAIRYTALE?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう、
じゃねぇよ！　
どんなミラクルだよ！
カニさん助けて番狂わせって、
おとぎ話かーい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: However, the victor was decided and so...
text_block_list.orig_text: しかし、雌雄は決した──

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, to all the customers waiting to go parasailing, please come in~... Um, young lady, who's going to be riding with you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
パラセーリ
ングでお待ちのお客様、
どうぞ～
……ええと、
一緒に乗られるのはあなたと……？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I'm with Master {0} here.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}様です。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: You and this boy. I see~... I knew it... Let's see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたと、
こちらの方。
なるほど～……
ですね……
ええっと……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I got a little excited when that transcendent miracle happened, but now that my mind is clearer about it, this setup was the most reasonable choice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
超絶ミラクルが起きて少し興奮しちまったが、
よく考えれば
これが一番妥当な人選だ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Make sure to have fun! Bro, Rem!
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しんで来いよ
兄弟、
レム！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'm sorry for ruining your excitement here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～、
盛り上がってるとこ申し訳ないんですけど。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah?
text_block_list.orig_text: うん？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Could you do it? A member change...
text_block_list.orig_text:
できます？
メンバー、
チェンジ。

text_block_list.name: Rem Subaru
text_block_list.text: Change, you say...?  Change!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
「ちぇんじ、ですか……？」
「チェンジィ！？」

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. Usually there'd be no issue, but the wind is really strong in the sky today. Piloting is going to be more difficult than usual so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません～
いつもは許容なんですが。
実は今日、
上空が風、
強めで。
操縦の難易度が若干高めなんですよね。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: So if we're talking pairs, I'd like your balance to be as equal as possible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なので
ペアの場合、
なるべく
バランスを揃えていただきたくて。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Their balance...? In other words...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
バランスって、
つまり……？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm talking about weight balance. I would like to have two people with as little difference in weight as possible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
体重の。
なるべく
体重差が少ないお二人でお願いしたく。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: And now there's a weight restriction in the way! It's true that there seems to be a big difference between Rem and my Bro in that department...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここでまさかの体重規制！
確かにレムと兄弟とじゃ、
かなり違いはありそうだが……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: But if that's really the issue, then even I can't replace him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
だとしたら俺でもダメじゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: In that case... there clearly is someone whose weight matches Rem's... Clearly, she's not here... but... HAAA...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなると……
レムと体重が一致しそうなヤツか……
この場にはいねぇ……
が…………
はっ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I feel this overwhelming presence of someone looking down on me from behind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
背後に感じる、
この圧倒的に俺を見下す気配は……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Looks like it's my turn now.
text_block_list.orig_text: 出番のようね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Sister!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──姉様！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: I wonder why you two didn't call Ram from the beginning. Before we even get into the weight thing, there's no one else who should be sitting next to the cute Rem other than the cute Ram.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜ最初からラムを呼ばないのかしら。
体重云々の前に、
可愛いレムの隣に座るべきなのは、
可愛いラム以外にいないでしょうに。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: N-Nee-sama!! What are you doing here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
姉様！！　
なぜここに！？

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Is there a problem with Ram being here, Barusu? In the first place, you thinking of sitting next to Rem without telling Ram is... indecent. I'll be telling Lady Emilia all sorts of things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラムがいて何か問題があるの、
バルス？
そもそも、
ラムに黙ってレムの隣に座ろうなんて……
いやらしい。
エミリア様にあることないこと報告するわよ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Just report what happened! Don't try to frame only me without reason!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あったことだけ報告しろよ！
無闇に陥れようとするんじゃねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: HAH.
text_block_list.orig_text: ハッ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: In the end, she didn't even tell me why she was there... Surely she hasn't been watching over me all day just like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局、
なんでいるのかも答えてくれないし……
まさか
一日中見張ってたとかじゃねぇだろうな……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: The howling of the loser Barusu is so loud and annoying. Now, next to Rem will be her respected older sister Ram. So there's no complaint about that, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
負けバルスの遠吠えがうるさいわね。
さあ、
レムの隣には尊敬すべき姉様であるラムが乗るわ。
それで文句はないでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: You're twins! Of course that'll be okay. Go ahead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
双子！
それならもちろんOKです。
どうぞー！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Rem. Let the losers bark on the ground.
text_block_list.orig_text:
行きましょう、レム。
負け犬たちは地上で吠えさせておけばいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: We're gonna fly.
text_block_list.orig_text: 飛ぶわよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: After all that slack-jawed work to decide on a pair, you turned the whole club upside down and snatched our efforts away? Nee-sama truly is one of a kind... Also, my Bro didn't even lose...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんなにもすったもんだしてペアを決めたのに、
全っ部ひっくり返してかっさらっていくとは、
さすが姉様だぜ……
あと、
兄弟は負けてねぇんだが……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Look, Rem. You can see the entire shoreline of Landosol from here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見なさいレム。
ランドソルの海辺が一望できるわよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: You're right...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 本当ですね……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...It's a very... beautiful view...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
とっても……
綺麗な景色、
です……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Despite your words, you don't seem to be happy. You're worried about Barusu and {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言葉の割に浮かない表情ね。
バルスたちのことが気になっているの。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, you saw right through me Sister...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
姉様にはお見通しですね……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Of course, being able to ride this thing with my Sister like this makes Rem very happy. I thought that if I tried it once and enjoyed it, I'd definitely go back and do it once more with you later on, Sister.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
姉様とこうして二人で乗れることは、
レムにとって
これ以上ない幸せです。
一度乗ってみて、
楽しかったら
ぜひ姉様とも一緒にと
思っていました。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: It's just, I suppose I just feel bad... I'm sure Subaru and {0} wanted to ride it too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ、
やはり申し訳ない気もして……
スバルくんたちも乗りたかっただろうなと……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Rem, it's okay for you to just think about yourself too once in a while.
text_block_list.orig_text: レムもたまには自分のことだけを考えてもいいのよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Sister...
text_block_list.orig_text: 姉様……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: ............Well, that said...

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Rem's inherited her kindness from Ram, so it can't be helped. Besides, there's no need to feel sorry for them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムの優しさはラム譲りだから仕方ないわね。
それに、
申し訳なく思う必要はなさそうよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: As always, he's a strong man who fights his bad luck head-on.
text_block_list.orig_text: 相変わらず悪運だけは強い男ね。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: REEEEMMMM! RAAAAMMMM! WAIT!

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: That's...!
text_block_list.orig_text: あれは……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: You two... How on earth did you get here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも……
いったいどうやって？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: We finally caught up to you! I heard all about it, Rem. You cleaned this coast together with my Bro here, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようやく追いついたぜ！
聞いたぞレム。
前に兄弟と一緒に
海岸掃除をしたんだってな？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Cleaning the coast...? Oh, yes, I did. When I was patrolling the beach together with Master {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海岸掃除……？
あ、
はい、
させていただきました。
{0}様と海岸のパトロールをした時に。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: The parasailing staff remembered what you did, and actually, when he saw Rem flying from behind he finally noticed who it was he had in front of him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時のことをパラセーリングのスタッフが覚えててさ、
てか、
空飛ぶレムの後ろ姿見て、
今更思い出したらしくて！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: He said he was really grateful that you two were able to remove all kinds of things from the beach including huge driftwood that usually would require multiple people!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でっけー流木とか、
数人がかりじゃなきゃできないものを
一人でぜ～んぶ取っ払ってくれて、
すんげー助かったって！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: That's why, as a thank-you for both my Bro here and for you, Rem, he said he'd give us an extra ride free of charge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
その時のお礼に、
『レムへの』お礼に、
オマケで俺たちのことも乗せてくれるんだとよ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: So that's what happened...!
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだったんですか……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: That's... truly amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
とってもよかったです！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's amazing, Rem!
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱりレムはすげぇよ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Everyone here in Landosol is so kind, and they even made Rem's wish come true, everyone here is the best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とんでもありません。
ランドソルの皆様の方こそ親切で、
レムの望みまで叶えてくださって、
最高です！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: It's true, everyone here is incredibly nice. But it's only because Rem was kind to them that they were able to give back. Right, Nee-sama?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
ここのヤツらはみんなめちゃくちゃいいヤツらだ。
でも、
それはやっぱりレムが親切にしたから返ってきたんだよ。
なぁ
姉様。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Surprisingly, for once, I agree with Barusu. I wonder if it's going to snow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
珍しくバルスと同意見ね。
雪でも降るのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Rem's kindness always makes all sorts of people happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムの思いやりは、
いつだって人を幸せにするわ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: How kind of you, Sister... Rem is happy she was able to be of service to everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉様まで……
レムも、
きちんと皆様のお役に立てていたんですね……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Um! There are also lots of other "summer beach-like games" that I want you and Subaru to enjoy, Sister.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あの！
他にも、
姉様やスバルくんに楽しんでほしい、
『海の遊び』がたくさんあるんです。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: "Beach-like games"?
text_block_list.orig_text: 海の遊び？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. Actually, I was doing some research with the help of Master {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
実は、
{0}様に手伝ってもらいながら、
リサーチしていました。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: From right here we can see everything, so let me introduce those games to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここからならちょうど全部見えるので、
紹介しますね！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: First, you can see the beach house over there. There are so many delicious things you can eat! And then, the fishing boats in the fishing port over there, you can go deep sea fishing on them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは、
あそこに見える海の家。
おいしいものがとってもたくさんあるんです。
それから
あっちの漁港の漁船、
あれに乗って沖釣りを──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Dearest Sister? Is there something on Rem's face?
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉様？
レムの顔になにかついていますか？

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: No. It sounds like Rem had a fun summer, so Ram is happy too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ。
レムが楽しい夏を過ごしたのなら、
ラムも嬉しいわ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Fun... Yes, I suppose that's correct. I was researching various things with Master {0} to make you, Sister, and Subaru-kun happy, but before I knew it, Rem was enjoying her time too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しい……
はい、
そうなんです。
姉様やスバルくんたちに楽しんでもらうために
色々と調べていたのですが
いつの間にか
すっかりレムも楽しんでいました。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: That's what summer vacation should be all about. Let me hear all of it. I want to know all of Rem's summery stories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでこそ、
サマーバケーションよ。
続きを聞かせてちょうだい。
レムの、
楽しかった話を。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes! Over there on the beach, the "Seaside Summer Festival" is being held, and there's a statue of Subaru made by Rem that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
浜辺のあの辺りでは
『海辺の夏祭り』が開かれていて、
レムの作ったスバルくん像があります──

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふふふ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Like a wind blowing through the summer sky, Rem's "introductions" to various summer games continued with the fun she had during them oozing out freely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏空に吹く風のように、
レムの「紹介」は楽しげに続くのであった。
